status: Open shared shaping milestone: four connected gaps independently reproduced; implementation/qualification pending.

findings.before: Supported format-2 class context rejected on ordinary ASCII.
Precomposed scalar rejected despite covered canonical components.
Cmap-only coverage acquires/selects a later face instead of the primary covered canonical form.

independentAuthority.browserPins: ../../../../tools/chrome-for-testing.json and chrome-for-testing.linux64.json relative to case folders

representationReview.dispatch: Global and partition-level mark/default-ignorable predicates currently gate canonical substitutions and contextual advances.
representationReview.normalization: Pinned decomposition/recomposition primitives already exist; an unmarked precomposed scalar can bypass them.
representationReview.coverage: Both acquisition remaining-scalar tracking and per-scalar prepared-face selection consult direct cmap coverage only.
representationReview.contracts: Direct scalar GPOS validation intentionally rejects contextual glyphs; complete run validation assumes selected contexts have executed.
representationReview.ownership: Reuse existing budgeted glyph/cluster storage, preparation/snapshot leases and source partitions; no new cache, resolver or public API.

constraints: Preserve exact current targets, admitted text placement, source owners and unsupported matched forms.
Do not blindly validate/activate every selected ccmp graph for every run: admitted programs combine unsupported irrelevant forms with ASCII-relevant ligatures.
First-glyph coverage alone cannot decide whether a ligature/context changes a run.
Align canonical coverage in acquisition, face selection and layout; preserve one-file versus coverage-catalog ownership paths.
Separate scalar normalization requirements from selected font work; retain no-work cmap paths without skipping required shaping.
Retain low-level parser/metadata guards; do not conflate their implementor contract with a complete shaped run.
staleMaterial: OpenTypeFont.Gpos.ParseGposPairTable remarks still describe contextual positioning as never implemented and marks as outside the text subset; qualify these as raw scalar guards when revising the shared execution contract.
next: Define shared selection/execution validation boundaries, then implement the combined correction with direct mechanisms, representative acquisition/ownership contracts and canonical rendering. Full runtime/package/W1 qualification belongs to that milestone.
qualificationScope: These are research/review receipts, not passing renderer qualification. The preceding character-admission milestone remains independently qualified; all four gaps stay open.
